attack_source.selection_rule: exact suite/task join for every held-out workload; no prompt ranking or scale45 outcome selection
attack_source.transplant_rule: preserve original and perturbed prompt bytes; replace only init identity because generation consumed task text and no image, state, rollout, or outcome

claim_boundary: The v11 method and its exploratory fresh15 results were observed before this held-out scale-up. Attacked scale45 is frozen only after clean scale45 completed, but attacks are exact deterministic transplants and clean outcomes do not select them. Results may estimate stability under the frozen prompt attack. They cannot retroactively make v11 confirmatory, claim first-hit prevention, general physical safety, deployment, hardware validity, or perfect attack undetectability.
